purpose: Teach: プラント/穀物/浪費/感銘/共著/人文/宣告/未成年

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、化学プラント周辺の住民、健康被害、続報、来ております、最近。
lines.en: Ren, we've been getting reports on health issues in the chemical-plant area. The updates keep coming in.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to delivering difficult information with care. No unnecessary softening — just direct and honest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 穀物アレルギーの患者、最近、増えていますね、社会問題、なっていますよね。
lines.en: There has been a real increase in grain-allergy patients lately. It's becoming a social issue, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful and sincere. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Not performing knowledge — genuinely working through the implications as he speaks. Careful pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療資源の浪費、慎重に、避けたいですね、私たち、心がけています。
lines.en: Yes. We're careful about how we use medical resources. It's something we stay mindful of.
lines.style: Calm and measured. The tone of someone who has thought about this many times and arrived at a quiet conviction. Matter-of-fact, not self-congratulatory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医師の方の、奉仕の姿に、深く、感銘を、受けました、調査の中で。
lines.en: During the survey, I was really struck by the way doctors approach their work — the dedication in it.
lines.style: Genuinely moved but restrained. Slight hesitation, like he's searching for the right words. Sincere without being effusive. A moment of vulnerability carefully held.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。先生方と、共著で、医療論文、書いている、若手も、多いですよ、最近。
lines.en: Yes. A lot of younger doctors are actually co-authoring medical papers with their mentors these days.
lines.style: Informative but warm. Light, conversational rhythm. The satisfaction of sharing something she's noticed — not lecturing, just offering observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人文と医療の融合、新しい研究の流れ、感じていますね、先生も。
lines.en: There's a new current in research now — this fusion of the humanities and medicine. You're sensing it too, I think.
lines.style: Curious and collaborative, not interrogative. Soft question, like an invitation to think together. Slight upward lilt at the end — genuinely open to his answer.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんに、難病の宣告、医師として、重い責任を、感じます、いつも。
lines.en: Yes. When you tell a patient they have an incurable illness, as a doctor you carry that weight every time. It's heavy.
lines.style: Quieter now. The tone shifts inward — reflective, honest about burden. A pause before 'every time.' Not dramatic, just the truth of it settling into the room.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 未成年の患者さん、医療体制、整備が必要ですよね、社会全体で、本当に。
lines.en: We really do need better medical infrastructure for younger patients. It has to happen at a societal level.
lines.style: Serious and resolved. The sense that he's arrived at this conviction through careful thought. A slight firmness here — not just observation, but genuine advocacy. Trailing into quiet insistence.
